label: rs-c18k12-n3
_why: COST LEVEL AND COST SLOPE AS SEPARATE DIALS (user, 2026-10-14: "I want to reduce capital abundance and depeasantation. I'd push C some more, but I'm already unhappy with the fact that payback periods on e3 are not significantly better than e2" -> a cost1 factor, "Let's try C=1.8 and cost1=1.2", "Go on with n=3 under this new config"). Book config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-c18k12.json = the canon jex-dam4s-rs-x25 regenerated through its own recorded chain with make_ab_config --cost-ratio 1.8 --cost1 1.2 in place of --cost-ratio 1.9 (the new flag: one multiplier on every rung's building_cost, recorded as _ab.cost1, re-derived by L31; proven to trip on the record stripped and on one hand-edited cost). The unchanged chain was first proven to reproduce the canon with 0 content differences and an identical tree twin. Field diff against the canon: building_cost on 56 rungs (records aside), nothing else: e0 x1.27 (crafts 6 -> 8 points), e1 x1.20, e2 x1.14, e3 x1.08 (the ladder pivots at the e1 anchor). ai_value, recipes, defines and the cost divisor (pinned 0.000125) untouched. Measured canon paybacks at 1935 in the shortlist (F227's three runs, GBP 600/point): e1 8.6-11.8 y, e2 7.6-10.6 y, e3 7.1-7.9 y.

_arms.c18k12: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-c18k12.json} (+ its tree twin, the canon's byte for byte).

_comparison: the canon: F227's jex-dam4s-rs (20261012_203800_jex-dam4s-rs-stitched-n3; x25 differs from it only in the universities' innovation and is unmeasured) on the register with criteria.mjs defaults of 2026-10-13 (world-GDP aim 0.90-1.00, the closed-major term); the C 2.0 batch on the same book (20261012_224416_rs-c20-n3, F228: 1 intact / 1 stall / 1 runoff); vanilla n=16 (20260821_131149).

_predictions.primary_effect: static estimate on F227's end state, same capital, ~1/1.15 of the tiered levels (the capital-weighted mean of e1 1.20 / e2 1.14 / e3 1.08): world GDP about -6 to -7%, the shortlist's about -9 to -10%; U* (unemployed + peasants) +1.3 to +1.8 pp world, +2.8 to +3.4 pp shortlist; Germany and Britain about +3.5 to +4 pp. Feedback (a smaller pool, dearer construction inputs) is expected to enlarge it, higher tiered prices to shrink it.
_predictions.GDP: world GDP end state below the canon's 1.04/1.09/1.45, the intact seeds around 0.90-1.05; the runoff seed less likely; a stall seed possible (C 2.0 on this book had one)
_predictions.payback: e3's payback improves against e2's by ~5% (one C step of 1.8/1.9); every rung's payback longer than the canon's
_predictions.hoard: pool H and the closed-major term (gerCM) below the canon's
_predictions.prices: PI/PP a little higher than the canon's (fewer tiered levels)
_predictions.play: play time at or slightly under the canon's (a smaller world)

_stop_rule: none: a fixed n=3 (the user's instruction), every run plays to 1936; the stop watcher is NOT armed.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Do NOT edit the emitters, the generators or the book while it runs.
